button.label: Match width
button.supertip: Sets the width of every selected shape to the width of the FIRST-selected (reference) shape. Top-left corners stay put.

button.label: Match height
button.supertip: Sets the height of every selected shape to the height of the FIRST-selected (reference) shape.

button.label: Match size
button.screentip: Match width AND height to reference
button.supertip: Sets width and height of every selected shape to those of the FIRST-selected (reference) shape.

button.label: All like largest
button.supertip: Resizes every selected shape to the size of the largest (by area) shape in the selection.

button.label: All like smallest
button.supertip: Resizes every selected shape to the size of the smallest (by area) shape in the selection.

button.label: Set exact size (cm)…
button.supertip: Type an exact width and/or height in cm for all selected shapes. Leave a value empty to keep it.

button.label: Scale by %…
button.supertip: Scales every selected shape by a percentage about its own centre.

button.label: Stretch left edge to reference
button.supertip: Moves each shape's LEFT edge to the reference shape's left edge; the right edge stays.

button.label: Stretch right edge to reference
button.supertip: Moves each shape's RIGHT edge to the reference shape's right edge; the left edge stays.

button.label: Stretch top edge to reference
button.supertip: Moves each shape's TOP edge to the reference shape's top edge; the bottom edge stays.

button.label: Stretch bottom edge to reference
button.supertip: Moves each shape's BOTTOM edge to the reference shape's bottom edge; the top edge stays.

toggleButton.label: Align to slide
toggleButton.screentip: Toggle: align to slide vs align to selection
toggleButton.supertip: Pressed: the align buttons align every shape to the SLIDE. Not pressed: they align to the SELECTION's reference shape (the FIRST one you selected).

button.label: Left
button.supertip: Align left — to the slide edge or to the reference shape, per the toggle.

button.label: Centre
button.supertip: Align horizontal centres — to the slide or to the reference shape, per the toggle.

button.label: Right
button.supertip: Align right — to the slide edge or to the reference shape, per the toggle.

button.label: Top
button.supertip: Align top — to the slide edge or to the reference shape, per the toggle.

button.label: Middle
button.supertip: Align vertical middles — to the slide or to the reference shape, per the toggle.

button.label: Bottom
button.supertip: Align bottom — to the slide edge or to the reference shape, per the toggle.

button.label: Swap two shapes
button.supertip: Swaps the CENTRE positions of exactly two selected shapes.

menu.label: Pick up / apply
menu.supertip: THOR pattern: pick up position and size once, then stamp it onto shapes on ANY slide — e.g. to make every title sit identically.

button.label: Pick up pos + size
button.supertip: Remembers the reference (first-selected) shape's position and size for the Apply buttons.

button.label: Distribute H
button.supertip: Distributes the selected shapes horizontally with EQUAL gaps; the outer shapes stay put. Needs 3+ shapes.

button.label: Distribute V
button.supertip: Distributes the selected shapes vertically with EQUAL gaps; the outer shapes stay put. Needs 3+ shapes.

button.label: Fixed gap horizontal…
button.supertip: Places the shapes left-to-right with an exact gap in cm; the leftmost shape anchors the row.

button.label: Stack horizontally (zero gap)
button.supertip: Abuts the shapes left-to-right with no gap.

button.label: Arrange in grid…
button.supertip: Lays the selection out in N columns. Shapes are placed in SELECTION order; the reference shape's top-left corner is the grid origin.

button.label: Heading font
button.supertip: Applies the THEME heading font — text keeps tracking the theme.

button.label: Body font
button.supertip: Applies the THEME body font — text keeps tracking the theme.

button.label: Grow
button.supertip: Increases every text run by 2 pt — mixed sizes keep their differences.

button.label: Match reference font
button.supertip: Copies the FIRST-selected shape's font name, size, bold/italic and colour to the other selected shapes.

gallery.label: Fill
gallery.supertip: Live palette of THIS deck's theme colours (plus lighter/darker rows). Applied as theme colours, so shapes follow future theme changes.

gallery.label: Line
gallery.supertip: Applies a theme colour to the outline of the selected shapes.

gallery.label: Text
gallery.supertip: Applies a theme colour to the text of the selected shapes.

gallery.label: Fill + line
gallery.supertip: Paints the whole shape: fill AND line in one theme colour.

button.label: Refresh palette
button.supertip: Reloads the galleries from the ACTIVE presentation's theme — use after switching decks or changing the theme.

menu.label: Select same
menu.supertip: Extends the selection to every shape on the slide matching the reference (first-selected) shape.

button.label: Off-slide here
button.supertip: Selects every shape parked fully outside this slide's area (gutter junk).

button.label: Off-slide report
button.supertip: Lists all fully off-slide shapes across the whole deck.

button.label: Deck language
button.supertip: Sets the proofing language of EVERY text frame — slides, notes, masters and layouts — in one go.

button.label: Remove notes
button.supertip: Deletes the speaker notes of every slide (asks first) — send-out preparation.

button.label: Unused masters
button.supertip: Deletes slide masters and layouts no slide uses, and reports what was removed.

button.label: Inspector
button.supertip: Position/size read-out (in cm) of the reference shape — also a debugging aid.

menu.label: Harvey ball
menu.supertip: Inserts a theme-coloured Harvey ball drawn from native shapes (not a picture).

menu.label: RAG status
menu.supertip: Inserts a red/amber/green status dot (brand-fixed colours by design).

button.label: Guide grid
button.supertip: Builds margin and column guides from your margin / columns / gutter input.

button.label: From selection
button.supertip: Adds guides on the selection's bounding box.

button.label: Build / update
button.supertip: Creates one divider slide per PowerPoint section, with the agenda list and the current section emphasised. Rerun any time — dividers are tagged and rebuilt in place.

button.label: Pick up format
button.supertip: Remembers the reference shape's complete format for repeated applying.

button.label: Apply format
button.supertip: Applies the picked-up format to all selected shapes — works across slides, as often as you like.

toggleButton.label: Sticky painter
toggleButton.supertip: While ON, every shape you click receives the picked-up format. Click again to stop. (If no format was picked up, the first selected shape becomes the source.)

button.label: Match adjustments to reference
button.supertip: Copies corner radius / chevron angle / etc. from the reference to same-type shapes.

button.label: Deck statistics
button.supertip: Slides, shapes, words, fonts in use, hidden and off-slide object census.

button.label: Off-theme colours
button.supertip: Lists every hard-coded (non-theme) fill, line and text colour in the deck — those will NOT follow a theme change. Long reports land on a report slide at the end.

button.label: Select off-theme on this slide
button.supertip: Selects the offenders on the current slide, ready for the theme galleries.
